notes.title: Update notice
notes.notes:
Update notice (expected to be updated on April 30):
1. Added the 10V10 mode of the difficult version of the main level (producing home materials and a small amount of holy relics)
2. Added 3 new weekly team copies of difficulty (low probability of dropping level 6-9 corridor upgrade gem level scrolls)
3. Added 2 new red collectibles (one collection is linked to the number of photos)
4. Due to the increase in collections, the wishing tree has been adjusted to a rotation system to avoid the difficulty of drawing what you want (one type is changed every week)

notes.title: January 19th, major update of Zhan Ji
notes.notes:
Update announcement
1. Added Meryl SP skin
2. Added Beaumont SP skin
3.Up updates are adjusted to 1, 3, 5, and 7 every week
4. Added new collectibles gameplay
5. Added the race trial tower gameplay (collectibles will be obtained at level 200)
6. Add collectibles to the main level (those who have passed will receive difference compensation)
7. The drop rate of gift boxes in the team copy corridor has been increased.
8. Added new collectible upgrade props to the cloister gift box
9. Some new collectibles have been added to the Wishing Tree
